title: Kaisi hai ye khamooshi zindaan hai sakina
body:
KAISE HAI YE KHAMOSHI ZINDAAN MEIN SAKINA
Baad-e-pidar wo tera reh reh ke yaad karna
Dam ghut raha hai amma mujh se wo tera kehna
Bhulagi kaise madar tum ne sahi jo eza
<<MINI>>
Do kuch jawab beta qurban tujhpe madar
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis tarha ki ye mujh par uftaad pard gaye hai
Asghar gaya hai jabse godi ujard gaye hai
Aajaye mout mujh ko ab khak hai ye jeena
<<MINI>>
Do kuch jawab beta qurban tujhpe madar
<<DIVIDER>>
Dadi se apni jakar rudaad-e-gham sunana
Sujhe huwe tum apne ruqsaar bhi dikhana
Rowegi dekh kar wo tan par patha ye kurta
<<MINI>>
Do kuch jawab beta qurban tujhpe madar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere hi dam mein bibi zinda thi teri madar
Kyun ho gaye khafa tum mujh se aye meri dilbar
Be lutf zindagi ke the tum hi ek sahara
<<MINI>>
Do kuch jawab beta qurban tujhpe madar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ankhon mein cha gaye hai ab har taraf udasi
Girya kuna hai saare gham mein tumhare bibi
Saidaniyon ko beti do aake ab dilsasa
<<MINI>>
Do kuch jawab beta qurban tujhpe madar
<<DIVIDER>>
Is kam sini mein mujh ko ye kaise maut aaye
Ek pal bhi chain se tum sone kabhi na paye
Jis roz se chuta hai baba ka tere seena
<<MINI>>
Do kuch jawab beta qurban tujhpe madar
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaa’n mein aye Sohail ek mehshar bapa huwa tha
Baithi huwe lahad par maa kar rahi thi girya
Us dam tha bas yehi ek madar ke lab pe nauha
<<MINI>>
Do kuch jawab beta qurban tujhpe madar
